# Error #65: GovernanceAlreadyInitialized

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#65`
- **Variant Name**: `GovernanceAlreadyInitialized`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `ERROR`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceAlreadyInitialized` — governance_bootstrap was called but a signer set already exists.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::bootstrap_is_one_time`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::bootstrap_is_one_time). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// GovernanceAlreadyInitialized — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let g = Governed::new();
let mut set = soroban_sdk::Vec::new(&g.f.env);
set.push_back(g.a.clone());
set.push_back(g.b.clone());
Some(rejected!(g
    .f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_governance_bootstrap(
        &g.f.governor,
        &set,
        &crate::DEFAULT_VETO_WINDOW_SECONDS
    )))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked bootstrap_is_one_time
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Do not call `governance_bootstrap` again; rotate the signer set through `governance_propose`, the required signatures, and execution.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/rotation-runbook.md#3a-governance-signer-rotation-the-contracts-two-key-set`](../../docs/rotation-runbook.md#3a-governance-signer-rotation-the-contracts-two-key-set)
